subject: Legend text justification in development branch

messages.author: c7ad2ad4911b43aa
messages.subject: Legend text justification in development branch
parts:
Hello all,

I'm using the most recent ggplot2 development branch, which seems to have changed the default justification of legend text to centered. Does anyone know how to left justify the legend text? 

For example: 
dp <- qplot(data=diamonds, x=carat, y=price, color=cut)

# Right justification can be accomplished as expected: 
dp + opts(legend.text.align=1)

# Whereas attempting to left justify produces a center-ish but not quite alignment:
dp + opts(legend.text.align=0)

Any ideas?

messages.author: c7ad2ad4911b43aa
messages.subject: Re: Legend text justification in development branch
parts:
Thanks for the reply, Hadley. You're right, swapping out formatC for format in scale_labels.discrete fixed the issue.

Now I can stop trying to convince myself that I actually wanted all of my legend labels to be center justified.
